changeinfo.changes:
New Features
  • Added SceShell Composite support.
  • Added support for the Sony keyboard / IME.
  • Added support for system notifications.
  • Added support for the long-press PS button menu and other system overlays.
  • Added HomebrewPatch integration alongside HomebrewUpdate.

Video & Rendering Improvements

  • Added proper alpha/transparency handling for system overlays.
  • Added Final Display Geometry handling.
  • Improved Adrenaline / PSP / PS1 aspect-ratio handling.
  • Improved bilinear filtering.
  • Improved framebuffer and resolution switching.
  • Added safer blanking handling when switching display sources.

Fixes

  • Fixed stale frames remaining visible after display changes.
  • Fixed lingering Adrenaline / POPS images in OBS.
  • Improved handling of dynamic display changes and system overlays.
  • Improved taiHEN configuration detection for both ux0:tai and ur0:tai.

Stability & Performance

  • Improved SceShell capture fluidity, especially for video and YouTube playback.
  • Improved USB audio/video stability.
  • Improved handling of dynamic audio sources.
  • General stability improvements and internal cleanup.

SceShell Composite is mainly intended for recording videos, YouTube content, or using a single application at a time. For regular gaming, switching between multiple applications, or longer sessions, use the standard capture mode.
